A quick sum for your diary

MOT due? Check the date.

Use your MOT expiry date or, for a new car, its registration date. It is worked out on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere.

Which date do you have?
Tap to choose a date

Choose the expiry date on your certificate. Switching options clears the date.

From gov.uk: you can get an MOT up to a month (minus a day) before it runs out and keep the same renewal date. A new car needs its first MOT by the third anniversary of its registration.
